en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a town square with a prominent round water tower and adjacent school buildings behind a brick wall and trees. Two children stand in the foreground on a cobbled street. On the right edge there is a multi‑story residential building with balconies and shop signage at street level. Handwritten red text appears at the top, and a red number is written in the upper right corner.
